basic_info.description: The ideal choice for anyone seeking a move in ready home. Thoughtfully updated offering numerous upgrades throughout. Features include fresh interior and exterior paint, new roof, new flooring, and an abundance of updated touches throughout. The bathrooms are stylishly renovated. This spacious home features 4 beds 2 baths. The open concept living and dining areas are flooded with natural light from the new large window panes and the sky light.  This well lit home creates a warm and inviting atmosphere into the brand-new kitchen with new stainless-steel appliances, sleek countertops, and ample cabinetry for abundant storage. Each bedroom and bath provides comfortable space. Step outside to enjoy the private backyard ideal for entertaining guests, relaxing and experiencing the city skyline views. There is easy access to public transportation, parks, schools, shopping and dining, and a variety of choices all within close proximity. Enjoy all of San Francisco's classic charm right on Bright Street.  This beautiful home will have you and your family living the good life for years to come. WELCOME TO YOUR NEW HOME!
